local_ocr_sources: books\Courseware on Indian Polity by M Laxmikanth.pdf
provenance.current_linkage_note: Official sources checked through 21 August 2026 show the 2019 Act and 2024 Rules operative; no later citizenship amendment/rule altering the scheme was located. The 2025 immigration regime preserves but does not expand CAA citizenship eligibility; its 31 December 2024 exemption date is not the CAA's 31 December 2014 citizenship cut-off. CAA challenges have procedural Supreme Court orders in February/March 2026 but no located final judgment. Section 6A remains valid 4:1 with implementation monitoring, and the 2021 OCI notification remains the latest located Section 7B notification.
provenance.pyq_status_note: 2021 Prelims GS-I Q89 is the direct owner and 2018 Prelims GS-I Q12 is a genuine cross-topic citizenship-proof PYQ. Both question texts were verified from local official papers; direct local official keys were unavailable, so both answers are prominently labelled inferred. No direct Mains citizenship PYQ was located.
